_doc: Coins per mined block (feedback #36, 2026-10-14; temporary numbers, balance here). tools/build_yields.py -> purse/gen/*.
Values are coins per block and may have decimals (resolution 0.01): the purse keeps the hundredths per player
(nx.pfrac) and pays whole coins as they add up. Blocks not listed earn nothing and cost nothing to place
fortune_pct: extra yield per Fortune level of the pickaxe used (+40% per level).
Placing a listed block costs its value at the best Fortune (fortune_max), so silk-touch an ore, place it and mine it
again with Fortune earns nothing. What the purse can't cover becomes debt (nx.pdebt), paid out of the next mining.
Bump version when the numbers change: servers then overwrite the in-game values (#<block> nx.coinval) on /reload.
